summary: Cline's historical August 26, 2026 announcement says GLM-5.3 Flash (formerly Ox Alpha) is free. In the recommendation feed checked October 14, 2026, GLM-5.3 Flash is absent from the free list and appears under ClinePass instead; that listing alone does not establish free access. Confirm a FREE tag in the signed-in IDE/CLI selector before relying on this offer. Feed absence does not prove withdrawal, and current claimability remains unconfirmed. Free promotions rotate, have limited quotas and work only in the Cline IDE extension and CLI, not the API. Free usage may be used to improve model performance and quality. Null expiry means no announced end date, not permanent availability.
claim_steps: Install the Cline CLI if needed: npm i -g cline.
Open the model picker with /models; in the current CLI, go to /settings, select Cline as the provider, and browse available free models.

Confirm GLM-5.3 Flash (Ox Alpha) has a FREE tag in the signed-in Cline (usage-billing) selector. The October 14, 2026 feed omits it from the free list and lists cline-pass/glm-5.3-flash instead; ClinePass presence alone does not prove free access. Authenticated confirmation is still needed.

Use it only while free-tagged in the CLI or IDE extension and within the limited quota, not through the Cline API. Free usage may help improve model performance and quality. The earlier announcement and curator screenshot are historical evidence, not a successful current claim.
